executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $168.84 per resident day (40.2% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 20.5% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $141,677, 2.6% of the $5,525,672 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $962,199, $29.4 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $539,418 (56.1%), allocated fringe $96,492 (10.0%), non-wage costs $326,289 (33.9%). Raw food was $287,526 ($8.79 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $419,040, $12.8 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $335,394 (80.0%), allocated fringe $59,996 (14.3%), non-wage costs $23,650 (5.6%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $126,394, $3.86 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $80,427 (63.6%), allocated fringe $14,387 (11.4%), non-wage costs $31,580 (25.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; costs per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
